correctness.rationale: Sieve logic (reduced-form weights, fundamental-discriminant filter) and HNF ideal-multiplication verifier were independently re-executed: recompiled sieve at 500k reproduced all 131 archived hits exactly; independent Python naive enumeration confirmed calibration values and all 11 C25xC5 plus sample discriminants at h=125; recompiled hnf reproduced h and n_ord5 on samples; union of scan.log/scan2.log covers all 290 hits with zero missing/extra and n_ord5 split 279x4/11x24/0x124, matching the C125/C25xC5/(C5)^3 criterion. Cross-agreement of two independent enumerations plus identity-presence checks establishes the finite census.

originality.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING route: absence from topic.json is not adverse; it arose directly from the target finite-check machinery. Fused search over literal, equivalent (C5^3/5-rank-3/exponent-5), and dominance (Watkins/LMFDB/census) directions returned Watkins, Holmin-Jones-Kurlberg-McLeman-Petersen, Elsenhans-Kluners-Nicolae, and LMFDB as leads; each was fetched and inspected at body level. None states or implies the 290-count through 20M with the 279/11 structure breakdown and explicit discriminants. One upstream provider (OpenAIRE query 1) errored after retries; audit continued with SerpBase/OpenAlex/Crossref plus direct primary sources, so no gap was converted into priority.

value.rationale: Headline is a rigorously established exact census of a target-motivated natural object: all h=125 imaginary quadratic fields through |d|<=2e7 with full group-structure determination and unconditional exclusion of (Z/5)^3 in range, including the explicit 11-discriminant C25xC5 list and reusable certified pipeline. This is not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration; it constrains the recognized missing-(Z/p)^3 problem (Holmin et al. Conjecture 1.10) and is precisely the kind of retrievable exact datum future 5-rank work needs. Judged separately from the admittedly untouched infinitary target half, it is independently worth finding.

broader_coverage.evidence: Watkins proves complete F(N) for N<=100 via Goldfeld-Oesterle plus sieving; Holmin et al. give GRH-conditional F(h)/F(G) tabulation to 10^6 and conjecture no (Z/p)^n rank>=3 for odd p; Elsenhans et al. bound exponents <=8 (Theorems 1-2, Table 1-2). None publishes a complete unconditional h=125 census to any bound.
broader_coverage.reasoning: A broader theorem covering the claim would need to imply the exact 290-count and structure breakdown through 20M. Watkins stops at h=100; Holmin et al. is heuristic/GRH-conditional and conjectural for (Z/5)^3; Elsenhans et al. controls exponent, not h=125 membership. Hence no broader result subsumes the headline as a special case.
